title: 探针记录之间的映射空间
previous_design_failure: The old task specified the final-topology repair, probe preservation, idempotence, and full-faithfulness output; a generic point-probe reconstruction theorem almost solved it.

retained: Arbitrary U-small Hausdorff X and Y.
Fixed profinite probes and the two universes.
No local compactness or compact-generation assumptions.
replaced: The primary input now includes the parameterized mapping presheaf H_X,Y(S)=Nat(h_S times h_X,h_Y), rather than a required repair topology on X itself.
not_added: No topology for the answer is supplied.
No final-topology or compact-open construction is supplied.
No known exponential or continuity of evaluation is assumed.

changed_target: Realize all parameterized mapping records by a U-small Hausdorff mapping space and prove the evaluation-induced exponential law for every Hausdorff parameter.
terminal_result: M(X,Y)=k C_co(kX,kY), with the underlying maps detected by probes; its probe functor is the internal mapping presheaf. Compact-image evaluation proves the exponential law without local compactness of X.
minimum_acceptable_completion: Concrete U-small Hausdorff function-space realization, including underlying set and topology.
Natural representation for every profinite parameter.
Evaluation and the stated bijection for every Hausdorff parameter.
Naturality under all requested continuous maps and coherent universe bounds.
alternate_routes: Direct compact-open construction and compact-image proof of the k-space exponential law.
Known Cartesian closedness of compactly generated Hausdorff spaces plus the correctly applied probe embedding.
An equivalent topology defined by compact parameter families or a valid continuous-convergence construction.

shortest_valid_completion.route: Use compact-generation/full-faithfulness and Cartesian closedness with explicit k-products and k compact-open mapping spaces, then identify the presheaf exponential naturally.
shortest_valid_completion.assessment: These standard theorems permit a short expert solution; a self-contained proof has a substantial topological dependency chain. No empirical long-reasoning or failure-rate claim is made.
shortest_valid_completion.generic_point_probe_status: Point probes determine an underlying function but do not show the parameterized mapping functor is representable by any topology. The compact-open/exponential step is essential.

proof_dependency_chain: Construct U-small profinite covers of compact Hausdorff probes.
Identify profinite kification with compact-Hausdorff kification, preserving Hausdorffness and probes.
Recover natural transformations as continuous maps kX to kY.
Construct Hausdorff compact-open mapping space and kify it.
Prove currying by compact-domain and tube arguments.
Prove uncurrying by restricting evaluation to the compact image of a probe.
Translate the exponential law into all profinite mapping records and all Hausdorff parameter natural transformations.
optional_fully_proved_developments: Fortissimo topology yields additional probe-detected functions absent from C(X,Y) with the original topology.
Ordinary compact-open evaluation C_co(Q,R) times Q to R is discontinuous.
All Hausdorff realizations have canonically equivalent kifications, without an unjustified original-topology uniqueness claim.
likely_illicit_strengthenings: Assume input spaces are already compactly generated.
Assume compact-open evaluation is ordinarily continuous without local compactness.
Treat natural transformations as only originally continuous X-to-Y maps.
Claim all Hausdorff realizations are homeomorphic from equality of probe records alone.
formalization_effects: Must formalize profinite/compact probe comparison, compact generation, k-products, mapping topology, currying, and naturality.
Formalizing only the old final-topology theorem or singleton naturality would not cover the revised target.

public_sources.role: Primary author exposition of mapping spaces and compactly generated Cartesian closedness.
